transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... I know this might sound a bit hard to explain, but lately I've been completely convinced that one of my MBA classmates and a startup advisor are quietly coordinating opportunities for me. It's like certain comments they make in class, or even just Slack messages, are actually coded signals about where my career is supposed to go.
Have you been sleeping less than usual without feeling tired?

No, not really. I've been sleeping about my usual amount, maybe seven or eight hours a night. If I get less than that, I definitely feel tired the next day, just like normal. So, no, my sleep hasn't really changed.
How long have you been convinced that your classmate and startup advisor are coordinating these coded messages and opportunities for you?
It's been going on for about two months now. I'd say it started right around the time I began my part-time MBA prerequisite program, while still keeping up with my regular operations job.
Have you heard a voice speaking when no one was present?

Yes, actually, I have. Um... it happens a few times a week, usually when I’m working late on my school stuff or my operations plans for work. I'll just hear my name, or sometimes a short phrase like "go now." And it sounds so clear that I actually stop and check my phone, or I look around the room, even though I know I'm alone and there's no one else there.
How much have these experiences affected your ability to work or attend school?

It's definitely starting to have an impact. I mean, I'm still showing up to everything, but... well, at work, my manager has actually started documenting some missed handoffs and what they called unreliable follow-through on my end. And at school, my professor recently questioned my judgment on a group assignment. So, I'm still going, but my relationships at work and school are getting pretty strained. It got to the point where I just felt like I really needed to get some help.
When did you first notice any unusual experiences or changes in your thinking or functioning related to this problem?

I think I mentioned it a little earlier, but it's been going on for about two months. I really first noticed things changing right around the time I started my part-time MBA prerequisite program, while I was still trying to keep up with my regular operations job. That's when it all started.
